title: The old-world fern
description: A small unfurling kingdom, older than flowers and considerably less impressed by adventurers. Its bright fronds collect the last light beneath the garden wall.
alt: Pixel fern with curling green fronds in a weathered terracotta pot.

title: The patient sentinel
description: A sun-baked guardian with very firm boundaries. A tiny pink bloom offers the closest thing this cactus has to a welcoming handshake.
alt: Tall branching cactus with a pink flower in a clay pot.

title: Keeper of the sun
description: A golden compass that has never needed a map. Even on cloudy days, this little optimist insists the courtyard is facing the right direction.
alt: Golden pixel sunflower with a dark seed center and two green leaves.

title: A moment of stillness
description: A pale blossom rises from a pocket of quiet water. No quest marker, no ancient prophecy. Just a rather excellent place to take a breath.
alt: Pink lotus flower resting over green lily pads in a blue stone bowl.

title: The little elder
description: A whole woodland, patiently folded into one small tree. Its crooked trunk suggests it knows at least three secrets and will be sharing none of them.
alt: Compact bonsai with layered green foliage, a curved trunk, and a shallow pot.

title: The violet wanderer
description: A constellation of violet petals at the edge of the path. It arrived without an invitation, settled into a pot, and immediately became the best-dressed resident.
alt: Violet orchid blossoms on a slender stem above broad green leaves.
